name: working_nomads-jobs-mcp
description: Working Nomads (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Single keyless JSON array linked as 'API' from the site footer, with no documented query, location, page or limit parameters: nothing is sent and the whole current feed (a few dozen to a few hundred rows) is returned - filter client-side. Fields per the feed: url, title, description (HTML), company_name, category_name, tags (comma-separated string), location, pub_date. The feed has no id field, so id is the posting url.
